Players Committee card image of [[Jakku: Starship Graveyard (ALT)]] (only printing).

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jakkustarshipgraveyard_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e6e58df2da8bc676256fd425703a4c22d9dff6e8 e6e58df] (1 February 2025). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
